about: MonitorRecs starter catalog (2026-10-23): gaming, ultrawide, productivity, Mac & creator and portable monitors. The 88 gaming monitors came over from GamingRecs (read 2026-10-21/22); the rest were read on 2026-10-23 from the makers' own US pages (Dell, Apple, LG, BenQ, ASUS, Samsung). Every value comes from the page linked in sources; anything not read there is blank. Columns: shape = category, balance = panel (plus "curved" where the maker says so), surface = screen (size, resolution, max refresh rate, curve radius), core = main video inputs, weight = weight as the maker states it. Added 2026-10-25: 15 monitors that held first-hand reviews were waiting for (each value read from the page in its sources: maker pages, MSI datasheets, LG UK spec tables, and a retailer spec table for the two Gigabyte models).
